name: R2 Two-Family, Height District 1
source: LAMC 12.09 C (yards = R1 12.08 C.1-C.3; 2,500 sf per unit); 12.21.1 A.1 (R2: 33 ft; HD1 FAR 3:1)
verified: 2026-09-23 12.09 yard cross-reference and 2,500 sf/unit confirmed from code text; 33 ft confirmed from 12.21.1 text (Ord. 181,624)
notes: Yards are the R1 yards: front 20% of lot depth (need not exceed 20 ft), side 5 ft (lots under 50 ft wide: 10% of width, min 3 ft), rear 15 ft.
Height: 33 ft (not in Hillside Area or Coastal Zone). No flat-roof reduction in R2.
Density: 2,500 sf of lot area per dwelling unit (5,000 sf minimum lot = 2 units).
The R1 encroachment plane and RFA are not referenced by 12.09 and are not applied here.
